You are the fix implementer for the final whole-branch review of PR-C "Live Claude chat in the console" of the ruflo-console Claude Code plugin. One fix wave covers all findings below.

## Where
Worktree C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-chat, branch feat/console-chat (HEAD d98b02bb2), plugin dir plugins/ruflo-console. Windows 11, Node 24. vitest: from plugins/ruflo-console `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/<file>.spec.ts` (node_modules is a git-ignored junction — never commit it). Kit tests (`tests/*.test.ts`, import `claude-code/testing`) do NOT load under vitest; run them with `claude plugin test .` from plugins/ruflo-console (whole kit suite, ~2 min; on this Windows checkout many unrelated kit tests fail because of a test-fixture path issue fixed on another branch — compare against the base failing set and judge only chat.test.ts). Touch only plugins/ruflo-console. Do not push. Each commit ends with exactly `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <[REDACTED:email]>`. No new dependencies. Do not dispatch subagents. REQUIRED before each commit: `claude plugin validate plugins/ruflo-console` → "Validation passed".
Global constraints (verbatim): everything handed to the model goes through the existing `modelLine` sanitiser; transcript text is never written to disk, never placed in `console_state` text answers, never sent to a model by the console itself (ADR-486).
Engine API (grep, don't read whole): C:/Users/mariu/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/bundled-skills/2.1.286/e9359f1bd6280f63d9d038bce106683a/plugin-authoring/types/claude-code.d.ts (InputProps value/onInput, PromptSubmitResult `{ drop }` ≈8315-8322, SessionMessage) and reference.md in the same folder.

## Findings (verbatim, abridged) and controller rulings
1. [Important] "A refusal disappears right after it is shown. bindings.ts:211 + chat.ts:62: the send action is sendChat(...).then(() => chatLive ? refreshChatAndDraw(...) : …) and refreshChat runs `delete chat.error` on every successful read, so a refusal is set, drawn once, and wiped by the read that follows. Fix: keep send errors in their own field (sendError, cleared only when the next send starts), or have refreshChat clear only its own read error." → Do: separate `sendError` (cleared when the next send starts) from the read error; the view shows sendError until then.
2. [Important] "Every tool round-trip draws as an empty message from 'you'. chat-msg.ts:10 + views/chat.ts:53: user rows that carry only toolResults have text '' and are kept; linesOf draws an empty `╭─ you` frame each; they also eat the 50 drawn / 200 kept slots. Fix: drop user rows with text === '' and assistant rows with no text and no tools; add a spec from a realistic tool-loop transcript." → Do exactly that (filter in toChatMsgs or keepChat — say which and why).
3. [Important] "Transcript text is drawn without the codebase's own cleaning step. views/chat.ts:51-57 (linesOf) and :1106 (partial) use only clip(); the terminal passes every line through termText (harness.ts:72) — strips escape sequences, control, bidi and invisible characters and masks x.ruv.io invite codes. Fix: map each line through termText(line, SHOWN_CHARS, false) or equivalent in linesOf and in the partial." → Do it; test with an ANSI escape, a bidi override and an invite code in a message and in partial.
4. [Important] "The Send field is uncontrolled (views/chat.ts:1128-1135, no value, no onInput). Keep an in-memory draft in the chat side table (never in the snapshot); clear it once a send is accepted, keep it on a refusal." Also: a repeated Enter while sending/queued is silently ignored — show a short fixed note (e.g. "already sending — wait for it") instead. → Do it.
5. [Important] "The plan's kit tests are missing: plan C4 calls for tests/chat.test.ts run by `claude plugin test`. Add: open shows messages, Enter submits once, console_state has no text, preview off hides text" — plus Enter clears the field after an accepted send, and a refusal stays visible and keeps the text. Model it on an existing kit test (e.g. tests/nav.test.ts, tests/palette.test.ts).
6. [Must-fix] register.ts:843 appendPartial runs whatever the setting, so the live answer is held in memory with Session preview off, contradicting README/CHANGELOG "reads nothing". → Gate appendPartial on sessionPreview (one line) and test it.
7. [Cheap extras, do them] (a) `prompt.submit` can resolve `{ drop: reason }`: make hostOf.submitPrompt surface it and sendChat show a fixed "not sent: a hook declined it" (never echo the reason or the text); (b) add "\n" to partial when a new turn step begins (e.index > 0); (c) fix the stale comment at register.ts ~777 ("Both wait on the turn" → submit resolves when its turn starts, reference.md:125); (d) add tests that a consumer early close (gen.return()) reaches the upstream generator's finally and an upstream throw propagates through chatStep.

## Process
TDD (RED then GREEN) for 1–4, 6, 7a, 7b, 7d. Logical commits. At the end run: all tests/chat-*.spec.ts, ask-claude, room, render-smoke specs, plus `claude plugin test .` (report chat.test.ts result and that no other kit test changed status vs base d98b02bb2). Update README/CHANGELOG 0.44.0 bullets only where behaviour changed (e.g. the field clears after a send, refusals stay visible).

## Report (required)
Write C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-win\.superpowers\sdd\2026-10-10-ruflo-console-windows-nav-chat\pr-c-final-fix-report.md: per finding: change, files, RED/GREEN; spec and kit counts; validator output; concerns.
Then reply ONLY (<15 lines): Status, commits, one-line test summary, concerns, report path.
